title: rhododendron yakushimanum subsp. makinoi
intro: Rhododendron yakushimanum subsp. makinoi, commonly known as the Yakushima rhododendron, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, native to the Japanese island of Yakushima. The health benefits of Rhododendron yakushimanum subsp. makinoi include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Rhododendron yakushimanum subsp. makinoi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
